build_constraint_registry: build a ConstraintRegistry to link distribution constraints to transforms for bijective and non-bijective mappings
create_biject_to_transform: create a bijective transform from constraints.real to a target constraint using the biject_to registry
create_transform_to_transform: create a transform from constraints.real to a target constraint using the transform_to registry
register_custom_constraint_transform: register a custom constraint subclass with a factory function that returns a Transform in biject_to or transform_to
lookup_transform_for_constraint: lookup a transform for a given constraint object from biject_to or transform_to registry
